**Creative Call recap · Wed Nov 11**
Overall new-customer ROAS was 0.75 against a goal above 0.8, so spend may come down before Black Friday while the team feeds the under-supplied secondary angles. AVIA output rose from 6 to 10 briefs a week and the new target is 20 briefs every three days, about 50 a week, at 0.85 NC ROAS. Real-footage AI drama ads now beat Pixar and claymation formats, and a $2,000 bonus goes to the first AI drama ad that spends over $20,000.

**Discussed**
- Blood sugar, cholesterol, prostate and neuro are validated but not growing because too few briefs feed them
- More unaware ads wanted; the mix is too heavy on solution-aware
- Real-footage AI drama and organic B-roll with voiceover outperform animation formats
- Black Friday offer is in a two to three day A/B test; bottom-of-funnel creative already marked urgent for launch
- Revised brain landing page and new mechanism are live
- Statics: low CPC but off-target delivery; interest targeting as a suggestion proposed
- Senior video editor being hired for training; weak editors to be reported in Slack
- Editing tools moving from Higgsfield to Sume over about two months

**Decided**
- AVIA target set at 20 briefs every three days, about 50 a week, with the new PDP
- Creative for the new Black Friday offer can enter the pipeline now
- $2,000 bonus for an AI drama ad spending over $20,000
- Migrate editors from Higgsfield to Sume within about two months
- Dusan refocuses on AVIA; Elissa shifts video briefs toward AVIA

**Tasks (11)**
- Send the Black Friday offer link to the creative strategists — Youssef · due Nov 11
- Read the Black Friday offer A/B test after two to three days and pick the winning offer — Youssef · due Nov 14
- Decide on the performance call how far to cut overall spend while NC ROAS sits at 0.75 — Brandon · due Nov 11
- Raise AVIA brief output to 20 every three days (about 50 a week) for the new PDP — Creative team · due Nov 18
- Ask Damian to test interest targeting as a suggestion on the static ad sets — Brandon · due Nov 11
- Hire a senior video editor to train and coach the editors — Brandon · due Nov 18
- Move the video editors from Higgsfield to Sume — Brandon · due Jan 11
- Make message-led statics for the new angles alongside natives — Elissa Jabbour · due Nov 18
- Add the Logan naming convention to his briefs so they show in reporting — Logan Lapierre · due Nov 11
- Add Logan to his Slack channel — Brandon · due Nov 11
- Consider testing the Black Friday price on the plaque product page instead of only at checkout — Youssef · due Nov 18
